name: Quick Copy – Duplicate Posts & Pages
author: Iqbal Hossain

sections.description:
Quick Copy – Duplicate Posts & Pages is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to duplicate any post or page instantly, including all custom fields, featured images, metadata, and taxonomies, with just one click.

Perfect for bloggers, website owners, and developers, Quick Copy helps you create similar content fast without manually copying and pasting — ensuring a seamless workflow and accurate duplication.

🚀 Key Benefits

  • Duplicate Posts and Pages Instantly: Create a full copy of any post or page with one click.
  • Copy All Content and Metadata: Retains the title, content, featured image, custom fields, and taxonomies.
  • Preserve Categories and Tags: Duplicated content keeps all assigned categories, tags, and custom taxonomies.
  • One-Click Access: A “Duplicate” link appears directly under each post or page in your WordPress admin list view.
  • Safe Draft Creation: New duplicates are automatically saved as drafts so you can make edits before publishing.
  • Time-Saving for Content Creators: Ideal for websites with repetitive layouts, templates, or frequent content updates.

Whether you’re managing a large content library or building websites for clients, Quick Copy makes duplication simple, efficient, and reliable.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin repository or upload the duplicator-post-page folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to your Posts or Pages list, hover over an item, and click the Duplicate link.

That’s it — your new copy will be created instantly as a draft!
sections.faq:
What happens to the duplicated post or page?

The duplicated version is created as a draft and includes all original content, metadata, and taxonomies. “(Copy)” is appended to the title for easy identification.

Can I duplicate custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports duplicating posts and pages. Custom post-type support may be added in future updates.

Will SEO metadata and custom fields be copied?

Yes! All custom metadata fields are retained during duplication.

Can I edit the duplicated post before publishing?

Yes — the duplicated post or page is saved as a draft, giving you full control to edit before publishing.
